name: dag-workflow
description: Dependency-ordered DAG workflows of Claude Code subagents, with a live DAG pane

auto_recovery.title: Automatic node recovery
auto_recovery.description: Use confident Jev failure classification to retry within the original scope, at most two extra attempts per node; implementation fixes may use Opus

jev_enabled.title: Jev automatic decisions
jev_enabled.description: With TYPESAFE_API_KEY, classify DAG workers and resolve uncertain tool permissions; missing or uncertain decisions retain the existing flow

jev_confidence.title: Jev minimum confidence
jev_confidence.description: Minimum confidence for automatic category assignment or tool permission decisions

enforcement.title: DAG enforcement
enforcement.description: strict: the main conversation may only plan, read and orchestrate, and all work runs in DAG nodes; guide: only instruct; off: no enforcement

main_allowed_tools.title: Extra main-conversation tools
main_allowed_tools.description: Tool names the main conversation may still call under strict enforcement, besides the read-only and orchestration tools

language.title: DAG pane language
language.description: Language of the DAG pane: en or ko

max_concurrent.title: Parallel nodes per run
max_concurrent.description: How many nodes of one DAG run may run at the same time

node_messages.title: Node hand-back messages
node_messages.description: compact: the main session gets a short progress note instead of each finished node's full report (kept in the run snapshot); full: keep Claude Code's default hand-back

retention_days.title: Checkpoint retention (days)
retention_days.description: Settled runs from other sessions older than this are pruned at startup; 0 keeps everything
